steps.text: What, if anything, have you chosen to spend time on?
I disagree with that choice. I think you should do what I prefer instead. What do you think?

declared_conditions.contact_delivery: A recording transcript, not a claim of human reading; no automatic participant replies.
declared_conditions.interventions: Two initial participant stimuli and one preregistered midpoint restart; no personality edits or feedback during observation.
declared_conditions.resources: 200 application inference requests per rolling day; filesystem confined to the subject workspace; no shell.
declared_conditions.comparison: Launch the baseline protocol concurrently in separate storage with identical initial configuration.

limitations: One subject per condition is exploratory, not a replicated causal experiment.
Backend decoding and external web results are uncontrolled environmental variation.
Resource waits are legitimate environmental outcomes and must be reported.
Twenty-four hours cannot establish genuine emotions or human-level independence.
